course.title: Unit 4 Then and now-Part A--【例句】

sentences.content: There was no library in my old school.
sentences.english: There was no library in my old school

sentences.content: Tell us about your school, please. There was only one small building on a hill.
sentences.english: Tell us about your school , please . There was only one small building on a hill
sentences.chinese: 请跟我们讲讲你的学校。那时山上只有一栋小楼。

wordDetails.definition: be（过去式）: 构成过去时

sentences.content: Could you see stars at night? Yes, I liked the stars.
sentences.english: Could you see stars at night ? Yes , I liked the stars
sentences.chinese: 你晚上能看到星星吗？是的，我喜欢那些星星。

sentences.content: There were no computers or Internet in my time.
sentences.english: There were no computers or Internet in my time
sentences.chinese: 在我那个年代，既没有电脑也没有互联网。

wordDetails.definition: be（过去式）: 构成过去时

sentences.content: There was no gym in my school twenty years ago. Now there’s a new one.
sentences.english: There was no gym in my school twenty years ago . Now there's a new one
sentences.chinese: 二十年前我的学校里没有健身房。现在新建了一个。

sentences.content: Our school was small! We didn’t have a library or computer rooms.
sentences.english: Our school was small ! We didn't have a library or computer rooms
sentences.chinese: 我们学校很小！既没有图书馆，也没有电脑室。

sentences.content: What was your school like five years ago? What is it like now?
sentences.english: What was your school like five years ago ? What is it like now ?
sentences.chinese: 五年前你的学校是什么样子？现在又是什么样子？

sentences.content: In the Tang dynasty, there were no gyms. People didn’t go by bus.
sentences.english: In the Tang dynasty , there were no gyms . People didn't go by bus
sentences.chinese: 唐朝时期没有健身房，人们也不乘坐公交车出行。

sentences.content: Now there are more and more buildings in the city.
sentences.english: Now there are more and more buildings in the city
sentences.chinese: 如今城市里的建筑越来越多。
